items: Main-agent sufficiency check: 명시적 launch 직전 한 번만 실행 가능성 판단
Goal+Exec launcher worker: Workflow Agent 선언, background turn 시작, interrupted·blocked recovery
Work Unit Python supervisor: worker heartbeat·process liveness 감시, bounded same-id 재호출, compact ACK와 terminal/escalation 외부 경계
Workflow Agent: recorded decisions를 재질문하지 않고 Plan, Work, AI Review, Report 수행
Work Unit manager: revision·attempt·invocation chain·progress·result의 canonical owner
Specification manager: specification-direct 실행의 기본 저장소 canonical owner
Git worktree controller: 코드 변경용 .agent-factory 제외 worktree 준비·통합·일괄 정리

content.stateOwner: 기본 저장소의 canonical Work Unit execution-state; Codex app-server가 Goal과 turn history를 소유한다.
content.humanBoundary: Human은 실행을 명시적으로 요청하고 terminal 결과에서 rework 또는 complete를 결정한다. 중간 승인 절차는 없다.
artifactOwners: Intake manager owns canonical Intake JSON in the primary repository.
Specification manager owns canonical Specification JSON in the primary repository.
Work Unit manager owns canonical Work Unit JSON in the primary repository.
Git owns code branch and linked worktree state only.

items: Work Package manager: canonical profile, DAG validation, lifecycle, durable scheduler state, review, rework와 receipt owner
Work Package supervisor: 첫 compact JSONL ACK와 terminal/escalation 외부 경계, 내부 heartbeat/process-death 감시와 동일 package 재호출 owner
Deterministic executor: stable ready selection, maxParallel, node launcher, specification lock와 topological merge owner
Package integration worktree: target snapshot과 prerequisite 결과를 합성하는 .agent-factory 제외 branch owner
Resolution Goal launcher: node 또는 merge 오류를 recovering으로 기록하고 같은 idempotency key 재시도를 준비
Package integrator: Human complete 후 integration branch를 target에 한 번 통합하고 receipt 등록
